# InlineQuery

## Documentation

An incoming inline query.

When the user sends an empty query, your bot could return some default or trending results.

### Parameters

- **`id`** (`str`)
  Unique identifier for this query.

- **`from_user`** ([`User`](../user_and_chats/User.md))
  Sender.

- **`query`** (`str`)
  Text of the query (up to 512 characters).

- **`offset`** (`str`)
  Offset of the results to be returned, can be controlled by the bot.

- **`chat_type`** ([`ChatType`](../../enums/ChatType.md), *optional*)
  Type of the chat, from which the inline query was sent.

- **`location`** ([`Location`](../messages_and_media/Location.md). *optional*)
  Sender location, only for bots that request user location.

- **`matches`** (List of regex Matches, *optional*)
  A list containing all [Match Objects](https://docs.python.org/3/library/re.html#match-objects) that match
  the query of this inline query. Only applicable when using `Filters.regex`.
